description: The XR blockade had about 70 participants and sought to stop the prime minister's opening, but the captured account's policy focus centers on Equinor and the UK Rosebank field. A Norwegian state-policy demand for the morning blockade remains unproved.
required_followup: Find an explicit contemporaneous demand directed at Norway's government or state policy, not merely the PM's presence or a corporate target.

description: Journalen calls the later environmental-organizations gathering another marking and quotes direct government criticism, but gives no attendance estimate. The morning blockade's 70 must not be transferred.
required_followup: Find a same-time count for the later marking and clarify whether it was separately organized or part of the morning episode.

description: The Nov7 multi-city treatment-cut march is supported by an NTB wire report and a sector/organizer page. The sector page's displayed chronology is inconsistent and does not independently corroborate the crowd estimate.
required_followup: Find independent Norwegian local reporting for the date, count and national coalition; keep city-level counts separate and do not aggregate them.

description: The captured November searches did not establish a protest episode continuing from October or into December. Similar issue topics alone do not prove one continuous event.
required_followup: For any adjacent-month overlap found later, compare actual start/continuation reports, named organizers, demands and episode-specific dates before linking.
